books.title: The Psychology of Money
books.author: Morgan Housel
books.description: Timeless lessons about wealth, greed, and happiness that explore the strange ways people think about money and teaches you how to make better sense of one of life's most important topics.
keyIdeas: Success is not about what you know, but how you behave
Long-term thinking and patience are crucial for wealth building
Risk tolerance is more about sleep-at-night factor than mathematical optimization
books.targetAudience: Anyone interested in personal finance and behavioral psychology

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.description: A comprehensive guide on how to change your habits and get 1% better every day, using proven scientific and practical insights.
keyIdeas: Small improvements accumulate into remarkable results
Focus on systems instead of goals
books.targetAudience: Anyone looking to build better habits and break bad ones

books.title: Deep Work
books.author: Cal Newport
books.description: Rules for focused success in a distracted world, teaching how to develop your ability to focus without distraction on cognitively demanding tasks.
keyIdeas: Deep work is increasingly rare and valuable
Your ability to focus intensely is a skill you can develop
Structure your day to maximize deep work sessions
books.targetAudience: Knowledge workers and anyone seeking to improve their focus

books.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.description: A groundbreaking tour of the mind explaining the two systems that drive the way we think—System 1 (fast, intuitive) and System 2 (slow, rational).
keyIdeas: Our minds operate using two distinct systems
We are prone to specific, predictable biases
Understanding these biases can improve decision-making
books.targetAudience: Anyone interested in psychology, decision-making, and human behavior

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: A thrilling story about an astronaut who wakes up alone on a spaceship with no memory, tasked with saving humanity from extinction.
keyIdeas: The power of scientific thinking and problem-solving
The importance of collaboration across boundaries
Humanity's resilience in face of extinction-level threats
books.targetAudience: Science fiction fans and readers who enjoy scientific accuracy in their fiction
